title: Top targeted users
description: This query helps reviewing top targeted users with malware or phishing emails in an organization in last 30 days
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Email Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Microsoft 365 Audit Logs') and ('Threat Category' like '*Malware*' or 'Threat Category' like '*Phish*') | stats count as count_ by 'Target User Name' | sort -count_
